page_shape.entry: posting page has <a name=apply-now> and <a name=secondary-apply-now> 'Apply for this job' -> /apply_flow/applications/go?job_id=<id> -> redirects to /apply_flow/standard_applications/apply?job_id=<id>; also 'Join our Talent Network' link. Posting notice: 'Your browser cookies must be enabled in order to apply for this job.'
page_shape.form: form#newApplication method=post action=/apply_flow/applications; sections RESUME ('ADD RESUME' button), COVER LETTER (js-02, rich-text), CONTACT, source ('How did you first hear about us?' with dependent sub-selects), custom candidate_answer questions, Work Authorization / Visa Type / Security Clearance, EEO selects (Gender/Race/Veteran/Disability), optional Password (js-01), network opt-in (js-01), button#apply-button 'SUBMIT'. 'Log in' link at top.
page_shape.captcha: reCAPTCHA v2 anchor iframes (recaptcha.net, key 6Ld0C1Is…) x3

control_families.text: input[type=text] name candidate_card[<field>] id candidate_card_<field> with <label for> ending ':'; NO required attr anywhere
control_families.select: native <select> name candidate_card[<field>_id]; option[0] '- select -' or a default such as 'None Specified' / "I don't wish to answer" (pre-selected)
control_families.dependent_selects: hidden until parent chosen: source_social_network_name, source_board_name, source_career_fair_name, source_database_name, source_search_firm_id, source_ats_user_id (depend on source_id); work_authorization_visa_type_id (depends on work authorization = visa holder)
control_families.custom_question: textarea name candidate_answer[<id>] id candidate_answer_<id> (narrative) OR select id/name candidate_answer_<id> (choice); <label for> holds the full question text
control_families.resume: 'ADD RESUME' button; file input created on demand (not in DOM)
control_families.cover_letter_richtext: contenteditable editor with toolbar (Undo/Redo/Bold/…/Insert Link) under 'COVER LETTER' (js-02)
control_families.experience_education_hidden: hidden templates with selects position_start_date/position_end_date (year lists, 'pres'), education_graduation_date_1i (year), education_degree_id (13 degrees) — for optional add-experience/education blocks
control_families.password: input#password 'Password:' (js-01) — optional account creation; help text 'Or register with:'
control_families.network_optin: input[type=checkbox]#candidate_network_opt_in 'Recommend me for jobs at other employers.' PRE-CHECKED (js-01); help: '<Company> is a member of the JobScore Network. By clicking finish you agree to JobScore's candidate data…'

examples_seen: No need for a long cover letter. Instead, send your resume along with a paragraph that hits two things: 1. How you use an AI tool like Claude to run an SEO and GEO search program for your clients. Tell us what you built, what it automated, and what changed as a result. 2. A client win (big or small) that shows off your SEO and GEO chops. Think of it as your "show, don't tell" moment. Help us see how you think, execute, and get things done with data and storytelling:

Will you now or in the future require Unified to commence (“sponsor”) an immigration case in order to employ you (for example, H-1B or other employment-based immigration case)? This is sometimes called “sponsorship” for an employment-based visa status:
Are you authorized to work lawfully in the United States for Unified?
